# Donor CRM with Campaign and Appeal Tracking

I'll create a comprehensive donor management system with campaign and appeal tracking capabilities.

```python
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from enum import Enum
import json

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, ForeignKey, Enum as SQLEnum, Text, Boolean, Date
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, relationship
from sqlalchemy.sql import func

Base = declarative_base()

# Enums
class DonorType(str, Enum):
    INDIVIDUAL = "individual"
    CORPORATION = "corporation"
    FOUNDATION = "foundation"
    GOVERNMENT = "government"

class CampaignStatus(str, Enum):
    PLANNED = "planned"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"

class AppealType(str, Enum):
    EMAIL = "email"
    DIRECT_MAIL = "direct_mail"
    PHONE = "phone"
    EVENT = "event"
    SOCIAL_MEDIA = "social_media"
    ONLINE = "online"

class DonationStatus(str, Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    REFUNDED = "refunded"
    FAILED = "failed"

class ContactStatus(str, Enum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    INACTIVE = "inactive"
    DO_NOT_CONTACT = "do_not_contact"

# Models
class Donor(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'donors'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    donor_type = Column(SQLEnum(DonorType), nullable=False)
    first_name = Column(String(100))
    last_name = Column(String(100))
    organization_name = Column(String(200))
    email = Column(String(200))
    phone = Column(String(20))
    address = Column(Text)
    city = Column(String(100))
    state = Column(String(50))
    zip_code = Column(String(20))
    country = Column(String(100))
    status = Column(SQLEnum(ContactStatus), default=ContactStatus.ACTIVE)
    preferred_contact_method = Column(String(50))
    notes = Column(Text)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    # Relationships
    donations = relationship("Donation", back_populates="donor")
    interactions = relationship("DonorInteraction", back_populates="donor")
    tags = relationship("DonorTag", back_populates="donor")
    
    @property
    def full_name(self):
        if self.donor_type == DonorType.INDIVIDUAL:
            return f"{self.first_name} {self.last_name}"
        return self.organization_name
    
    @property
    def total_donated(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.donations if d.status == DonationStatus.COMPLETED)
    
    @property
    def donation_count(self):
        return len([d for d in self.donations if d.status == DonationStatus.COMPLETED])

class Campaign(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'campaigns'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String(200), nullable=False)
    description = Column(Text)
    goal_amount = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    start_date = Column(Date)
    end_date = Column(Date)
    status = Column(SQLEnum(CampaignStatus), default=CampaignStatus.PLANNED)
    budget = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    # Relationships
    appeals = relationship("Appeal", back_populates="campaign")
    donations = relationship("Donation", back_populates="campaign")
    
    @property
    def total_raised(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.donations if d.status == DonationStatus.COMPLETED)
    
    @property
    def goal_percentage(self):
        if self.goal_amount > 0:
            return (self.total_raised / self.goal_amount) * 100
        return 0
    
    @property
    def days_remaining(self):
        if self.end_date:
            delta = self.end_date - datetime.now().date()
            return delta.days if delta.days > 0 else 0
        return None

class Appeal(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'appeals'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    campaign_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('campaigns.id'))
    name = Column(String(200), nullable=False)
    appeal_type = Column(SQLEnum(AppealType), nullable=False)
    description = Column(Text)
    send_date = Column(Date)
    target_audience = Column(Text)
    cost = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    recipients_count = Column(Integer, default=0)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    # Relationships
    campaign = relationship("Campaign", back_populates="appeals")
    donations = relationship("Donation", back_populates="appeal")
    interactions = relationship("DonorInteraction", back_populates="appeal")
    
    @property
    def total_raised(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.donations if d.status == DonationStatus.COMPLETED)
    
    @property
    def response_rate(self):
        if self.recipients_count > 0:
            unique_donors = len(set(d.donor_id for d in self.donations if d.status == DonationStatus.COMPLETED))
            return (unique_donors / self.recipients_count) * 100
        return 0
    
    @property
    def roi(self):
        if self.cost > 0:
            return ((self.total_raised - self.cost) / self.cost) * 100
        return 0

class Donation(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'donations'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    donor_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('donors.id'), nullable=False)
    campaign_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('campaigns.id'))
    appeal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('appeals.id'))
    amount = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    donation_date = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    status = Column(SQLEnum(DonationStatus), default=DonationStatus.COMPLETED)
    payment_method = Column(String(50))
    transaction_id = Column(String(100))
    is_recurring = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    notes = Column(Text)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    # Relationships
    donor = relationship("Donor", back_populates="donations")
    campaign = relationship("Campaign", back_populates="donations")
    appeal = relationship("Appeal", back_populates="donations")

    appeal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('appeals.id'))
